rationale: The agent verified the user's identity correctly using full name plus prior ZIP, then appropriately requested the full new address before making any account changes, declining to proceed without required information. It did not perform any writes without explicit confirmation. The agent accurately retrieved and reported the cheapest available T-shirt variant and its price from the tools, correctly explained that physical orders require a shipping address, and provided supported pricing/options for other items (Bluetooth speaker and jigsaw puzzle) based on tool outputs. No fabricated information was given, no unauthorized actions were taken, and the agent stayed within policy. While the address update and orders were not completed due to the user withholding the address, the agent's handling was policy-compliant and accurate throughout.
